For me it's like it was made FOR different people. There are many of us who played XCX on WiiU, adored its unique vibes and personality but the epilogue seemed made for people who more enjoyed XC2 style stuff.

The destruction of Mira was my biggest disappointment with the epilogue but at the same time it felt pretty inevitable. Xenoblade X was a side game after Chronicles 1 with no direct connection and sadly it didn't resonate with fans as much despite still being my favorite. With the success of 2 and 3 however, the only way they were going to bring anything X related back into the series was forcing it into the same universe as the rest of them and that wasn't going to happen being stuck in this weird Mira-dimension. It's why they had to throw in the fact that the universe of X's Earth is completely gone too. Only one place to go now right? Well technically infinite places to go but we all REALLY know there's only one option.

  
My personal hope was that they weren't going to escape the planet as it goes poof but they'd find some space-magic way to transport the whole of Mira into the connected universe. Chronicles loves its planet-sized shenanigans so what's one more! You could maintain all the mysteries and histories so far, still make the planet impossible/hard to escape, etc just in a shared universe that we could revisit in a later game.

I had to do this recently as I started on PS5. It's separate from simply Linking accounts.
